name: code_parallel
description: Parallelize the coding agent: openspec_plan drives the openspec CLI to produce a proposal/specs/design/tasks change (reviewed via a human-or-AI-judge loop) and deterministically parses tasks.md into independent sub-tasks, a JQ task reshapes them into a dynamic fork, FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC runs a code_subtask (worktree->coding_agent->commit) per sub-task in parallel, then merge_worktrees merges the branches back into a change branch.

inputParameters.queryExpression:
.repoPath as $r | .codeModel as $m | .codeAgent as $ag | .codePromptTemplate as $ct | .codePromptTemplateSource as $cts | .maxTurns as $mt | .maxBudgetUsd as $mb | .changeDir as $cd | .specContextPath as $sc | .modelProfile as $mp | .modelPolicy as $mpp | .modelPolicySource as $mps | .modelPolicySha256 as $mpsh | .modelsConfig as $mc | .modelOverrides as $mo | ["Read","Write","Edit","Glob","Grep","Bash(python *)","Bash(python3 *)","Bash(node *)","Bash(npm *)","Bash(npx *)","Bash(cat *)","Bash(ls *)","Bash(pytest *)","Bash(go *)","Bash(cargo *)","Bash(git status*)","Bash(git diff*)","Bash(git log*)","Bash(git mv *)","Bash(git rm *)","Bash(mv *)","Bash(rm *)","Bash(mkdir *)","Bash(cp *)","Bash(touch *)"] as $dat | def patternfor(cmd): (cmd // "" | if (length) == 0 then null else (split(" ")[0] | "Bash(" + . + " *)") end); def allowfor(cmd): (patternfor(cmd)) as $p | (if $p == null or ($dat | index($p) != null) then $dat else ($dat + [$p]) end); (if .usePrecomputedPlan then .precomputedPlan else .result end).subtasks as $subs | { dynamicTasks: [$subs[] | {name:"code_subtask", taskReferenceName:.id, type:"SUB_WORKFLOW", subWorkflowParam:{name:"code_subtask", version:2}}], dynamicTasksInput: (reduce $subs[] as $s ({}; . + ((($s.files // []) | join(", ")) as $files | ($s.description + "
Target files: " + $files + (if $s.testCmd then "
Your check: " + $s.testCmd else "" end)) as $desc | {($s.id): {repoPath:$r, name:$s.id, model:$m, agent:$ag, maxTurns:$mt, maxBudgetUsd:$mb, prompt:($desc + "

The OpenSpec planning artifacts for this change are under " + $cd + " in your working directory — read proposal.md and design.md first, then specs/**/*.md, then your slice of tasks.md, before implementing."), promptTemplate:$ct, promptTemplateSource:$cts, templateKey:"code", promptContext:{subtask:$desc}, specContextPath:$sc, allowedTools: allowfor($s.testCmd), modelProfile:$mp, modelPolicy:$mpp, modelPolicySource:$mps, modelPolicySha256:$mpsh, modelsConfig:$mc, modelOverrides:$mo}}))), groupIds: ([$subs[].id] | join(",")) }

.repoPath as $r | .checksList as $subs | ["Read","Write","Edit","Glob","Grep","Bash(python *)","Bash(python3 *)","Bash(node *)","Bash(npm *)","Bash(npx *)","Bash(cat *)","Bash(ls *)","Bash(pytest *)","Bash(go *)","Bash(cargo *)","Bash(git status*)","Bash(git diff*)","Bash(git log*)","Bash(git mv *)","Bash(git rm *)","Bash(mv *)","Bash(rm *)","Bash(mkdir *)","Bash(cp *)","Bash(touch *)"] as $dat | def patternfor(cmd): (cmd // "" | if (length) == 0 then null else (split(" ")[0] | "Bash(" + . + " *)") end); { dynamicTasks: [$subs[] | {name:"openspec_run_subtask_check", taskReferenceName:("check_"+.id), type:"SIMPLE"}], dynamicTasksInput: (reduce $subs[] as $c ({}; . + {("check_"+$c.id): {repoPath:$r, id:$c.id, testCmd:($c.testCmd // "")}})), fixupAllowedTools: (reduce ($subs[] | patternfor(.testCmd)) as $p ($dat; if $p == null or (index($p) != null) then . else . + [$p] end)) }
(.joined // {}) as $j | [$j | to_entries[] | (.value.output // .value // {})] as $results | {allPassed: ([$results[] | (.passed // false)] | all), results: $results}

inputParameters.prompt: Act as a read-only correctness judge. Compare the current diff on this branch against the OpenSpec planning artifacts under ${openspec_plan.output.changeDir}/ (proposal.md, design.md, specs/**/*.md, tasks.md): is the implementation complete and consistent with every requirement and task? This round's real test-command results: ${checks_summary.output.result}. Note: each Test: command is executed as a single program invocation with no shell (no pipes, &&, or command substitution) — a failure whose output mentions a missing binary or a denied/unrecognized command reflects a malformed tasks.md Test: line, not necessarily a defect in the implementation; call that out explicitly in your findings rather than treating it as a missing feature. Return the required structured output with passed (boolean) and concise findings (array of strings). Do not edit any files.

inputParameters.queryExpression: { passed: ((.checks.allPassed // false) and (.judge.passed // false) and (.specValid // false)), notPassed: (((.checks.allPassed // false) and (.judge.passed // false) and (.specValid // false)) | not), checks: .checks, findings: ((.judge.findings // []) + (if (.specValid // false) then [] else [("OpenSpec validate failed: " + ((.specIssues // []) | map(.message // (. | tostring)) | join("; ")))] end)) }

inputParameters.prompt: The parallel implementation in this worktree failed verification. Fix every issue below, then stop — do not re-architect beyond what's needed to pass. Failing test-command results: ${verify_round.output.result.checks}. Findings (semantic judge and any OpenSpec spec-validity failure): ${verify_round.output.result.findings}. The OpenSpec planning artifacts are under ${openspec_plan.output.changeDir}/ (proposal.md, design.md, specs/**/*.md, tasks.md) if you need to re-check requirements. Note: each Test: command in tasks.md is executed as a single program invocation with no shell — if a failure is because the declared Test: command uses a pipe, &&, command substitution, a missing/misnamed binary (e.g. `python` where only `python3` exists), or anything you're denied permission to run, the fix is to simplify that Test: line in tasks.md to one plain invocation of the tool actually available (prefer pytest/npm/npx/go/cargo/node/python3), not to work around it or install something. Note: if a finding starts with `OpenSpec validate failed:`, the defect is in the OpenSpec artifacts themselves (malformed spec deltas, a missing Scenario, an inconsistent proposal/tasks.md) — fix the artifact under ${openspec_plan.output.changeDir}/ that `openspec validate` flagged, not the application code, unless the code and the spec genuinely disagree.

inputParameters.queryExpression: def num: if type == "number" then . else 0 end; {tokens: ((.prevTokens|num) + (.newTokens|num)), cost: ((.prevCost|num) + (.newCost|num))}

inputParameters.terminationReason: code_parallel verification did not pass within ${workflow.input.verifyMaxIterations} iterations.

inputParameters.queryExpression: def num: if type == "number" then . else 0 end; (.joined // {}) as $j | [$j | to_entries[] | (.value.output // .value // {}) | {status:(.status // "unknown"), filesChanged:(.filesChanged // []), costUsd:(.costUsd | num), tokenUsed:(.tokenUsed | num)}] as $g | (.planTokens | num) as $pt | (.planCost | num) as $pc | (.mergeTokens | num) as $mt | (.mergeCost | num) as $mc | (.verifyTokens | num) as $vt | (.verifyCost | num) as $vc | ([$g[].tokenUsed] | add | num) as $st | ([$g[].costUsd] | add | num) as $sc | {perSubtask:$g, subtaskCount:($g | length), tokens:{plan:$pt, subtasks:$st, merge:$mt, verify:$vt}, cost:{plan:$pc, subtasks:$sc, merge:$mc, verify:$vc}, totalTokens:($pt + $st + $mt + $vt), totalCostUsd:($pc + $sc + $mc + $vc)}
